subcategory_text: Risk management processes are established, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-9, RA-1 (Risk Assessment Policy and Procedures)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.7, Clause 6.1 (Actions to address risks)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.RM-01 (risk management objectives)
implementation_examples: Establish, manage, and obtain organisational stakeholder agreement on the privacy risk management process
Define process inputs, roles, decision criteria, and outputs
Reassess the process when the threat landscape or business environment shifts
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a privacy risk management process is established and documented
Determine whether stakeholder agreement is obtained
Determine whether inputs, roles, criteria, and outputs are clearly defined
Determine whether the process is reviewed at a defined cadence
